# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 17 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Jacob Blesses Aseneth

---

**1** Jacob came to Egypt in the second year of the famine, on the first day of the fourth month. Joseph went out to meet his father.

**2** Joseph said to his father: 'Come to Pentephres the priest of Heliopolis — his daughter Aseneth is my wife.' Jacob said: 'Bring her to me so I can bless her.'

**3** Aseneth came to Jacob and bowed before him. Jacob looked at her: 'Come here, my daughter.' He stretched out his right hand, put it on her head, and said: 'You are blessed by the Lord God Most High.'

**4** 'The Lord God will bless your husband forever and ever, and the Lord God will bless all the sons and daughters who will come from you, forever and ever.'

**5** Jacob kissed Aseneth, took her right hand, and brought her into Joseph's house.

**6** All of Jacob's sons came and bowed before Aseneth and said: 'Our sister is blessed! Our father and our God has blessed you, and God has established you forever.'

**7** Simeon and Levi, Leah's sons, loved Aseneth more than all their brothers did, and they became close friends with her.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
